special_event_policy.rule: Special is a core event category. Every round performs one independent random Special-event roll using the current base probability. A successful roll adds exactly one Special event; a failed roll adds none. Each successful Magnitude-11 check also produces a Special event. Magnitude-11 is separate from the standard Special roll and never converts a result into Ultimate.
special_event_policy.magnitude_11_policy: tracked separately only when required; a successful Magnitude-11 check generates an initially Special event, which must independently pass the Ultimate Reclassification Gate before final classification.
